jobs.name: Daily merged Git cleanup
jobs.prompt: Run the deterministic cleanup script. It scans all Git repositories under /root, fetches/prunes remotes, removes only clean eligible non-primary worktrees (using force only after explicit cleanliness checks), and deletes only branches with a configured upstream that is either gone or present and merged into the fetched default branch. Branches without configured upstreams are preserved. Successful runs emit no stdout and therefore deliver no message; only actionable warnings/errors notify the user.
